notes: ampm.fr 301-redirects entirely to the AM.PM brand shop-in-shop inside La Redoute (www.laredoute.fr/pplp/cat-85201.aspx). Direct HTTP fetch (curl_cffi with browser impersonation) was blocked by Cloudflare (cf-mitigated: challenge) on both ampm.fr and laredoute.fr; headed Playwright/CDP with a real Chrome channel also stalled on the Cloudflare 'Just a moment' interstitial for 30s with no resolution. Escalated to Claude-in-Chrome (robots.txt on laredoute.fr checked first, no Claude-specific disallow found): the Cloudflare 'Un coeur bat en vous' interstitial (reason: Country challenge) auto-resolved itself via its own JS verification within ~15s with no interaction/click from me (no CAPTCHA was solved). Inspected the full AM.PM main-menu taxonomy (Meuble, Linge de maison, Luminaire, Decoration, Art de la table, Jardin, Collection modulables, etc.) - no permanent seasonal/holiday nav node exists. Site search for 'Noel' resolved to a dedicated Christmas landing page 'La boutique de Noel' (noel-ampm.aspx -> /pplp/85201/98907/cat-274292.aspx), a true grouping/editorial page (carousel layout, no own product-count header) with 3 child sections, each its own PLP with a displayed count: 'Decoration de fetes' (258, genuinely a curated ~half-subset of the 514-item general Decoration universe, not a duplicate), 'Table de fetes' (207, a curated tableware subset distinct from the 186-item general Art de la table category, filters: Assiette/Verre/Bol/Plateau/Couverts = tableware), and 'Idees cadeaux' (953, excluded - its only 'sub-categories' are price bands (<=59e, <=119e, etc.) covering nearly the whole catalog, i.e. a Gift Guide/price-bucketed marketing construct per rules S17, not a genuine product category). Site search for 'Halloween' returned a genuine zero-result error page (errors/searchnoresults.aspx), proving the search discriminates. Search for 'Paques' (Easter) auto-corrected to an unrelated word (plaques) with no Easter category. Search for 'Saint Valentin' fell through to the generic La Redoute site (different brand/nav entirely, not AM.PM's own taxonomy) confirming AM.PM itself has no Valentine's category. Conclusion: AM.PM's only genuine seasonal branch is Christmas, with one true grouping page and two genuine seasonal PLPs (decor, tableware); the gift-ideas node was excluded as marketing/price-bucket, not a real category.
